patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...) From the game install folder, navigate into the "CinderellaEscape!_R12_Data" folder, and then the "Managed" folder Download the patch archive from the link below Extract the "CinderellaEscape!_R12_Data" folder from the patch archive into the game install folder mentioned above, mergin It's working if: On the main menu, there is an "R18" symbol on the bottom left hand corner of the screen. uncensorpat.ch checked this patch on PC.
